mostWorthwhile.text: Following fat from large droplets to smaller droplets and then broken molecules made bile's job distinct from enzymes' job.

leastWorthwhile.text: The pancreas fitting was the least interesting: it was straightforward and added no explanation in its result.

surprise.text: Bile spreads fat into smaller droplets without breaking the fat molecules; enzymes do that afterward.

arbitrary.text: The gland fittings had clear purposes from their pictures and the goal, though the pancreas fitting itself gave little feedback.

continue.text: I would continue: comparing the three foods made digestion understandable, and I'd be curious to see what happens to the smaller molecules next.
